description: Implement the livestream flow (B.1–B.5) for the artist 'My Page' flow. Both upload and live branches merge into shared Waiting Room and Streaming Room pages. Live branch adds OS selection, streaming tutorial, and test stream steps. Confirm page gets pre-listen audio. New backend loopback WebSocket for stream testing.

steps.task: Create stream test loopback WebSocket handler (src/handlers/stream_test_ws.rs). Accepts /ws/stream-test with session-cookie auth. Buffers ~10s of binary audio chunks, on 'play' text command sends them back at 250ms intervals. Sends 'playback-start' and 'playback-done' text frames.

sub_plan.description: Backend loopback WebSocket for stream testing

steps.task: Create stream_test_ws.rs with WebSocket upgrade handler. Auth via session cookie (same pattern as stream_ws.rs L39-L55). On upgrade: allocate Vec<Vec<u8>> ring buffer. Message loop: Binary(data) → push to buffer; Text('play') → begin playback; Text('stop')/Close → cleanup.

Implement playback logic: on 'play' command, iterate buffered chunks sending each as Binary frame with tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)) between them. Send 'playback-start' text before first chunk, 'playback-done' after last.

knowledge.notes: 250ms matches the capture chunk interval in useAudioCapture.ts (MediaRecorder timeslice=250ms). Buffer ~40 chunks for 10 seconds.

steps.task: Register module in handlers/mod.rs (pub mod stream_test_ws) and add route GET /ws/stream-test → stream_test_ws_handler in main.rs alongside existing /ws/stream route.
Run cargo check and cargo test to verify compilation. Fix any issues.

decisions: Server loopback buffer chosen over real RTMP roundtrip — tests full capture→encode→send→receive pipeline without going live
No rate limiting needed for test endpoint — short-lived session, single user

steps.task: Create useStreamTest composable for the test stream sub-step. Connects to /ws/stream-test WebSocket, sends audio chunks from useAudioCapture, plays back received audio.

sub_plan.description: Frontend composable for stream test loopback

steps.task: Create useStreamTest.ts composable. Expose state ref ('idle'|'recording'|'waiting'|'playing'|'done'|'error'), startTest(), cleanup(). Connect to ws[s]://host/ws/stream-test WebSocket.

Implement startTest(): start useAudioCapture recording, wire onData to send binary chunks via WebSocket, after 10 seconds stop recording and send 'play' text command. Transition state: idle→recording→waiting.

Implement playback: on 'playback-start' message, collect incoming Binary frames. Decode WebM/Opus chunks via AudioContext.decodeAudioData() and play via AudioBufferSourceNode. On 'playback-done', transition state to 'done'. Handle decode errors gracefully.

knowledge.notes: Playback decoding delegated to consumer via onPlaybackData callback. The composable provides the chunks; the UI component (FlowLive.vue B.3) will handle MediaSource or AudioContext playback.

steps.task: Extend useHostFlow composable with new flow steps and live-specific state. Add 'waiting' and 'streaming' to FlowStep type, add liveSubStep ref, liveTestPassed ref, selectedOs ref, and setLiveTestPassed()/setLiveSubStep() actions. Update canNavigateTo() logic.

sub_plan.description: Extend flow composable for merged flow

steps.task: Add 'waiting' | 'streaming' to FlowStep type union. Add new refs: liveSubStep ('os-select'|'tutorial'|'test'), liveTestPassed (boolean), selectedOs ('windows'|'macos'|'linux'|null).

Update canNavigateTo(): 'waiting' requires (isConfirmed && uploadMode==='prerecorded') || (uploadMode==='live' && liveTestPassed). 'streaming' requires canNavigateTo('waiting'). Keep existing 'live' logic.
Add setLiveTestPassed(), setLiveSubStep(), setSelectedOs() actions. Export all new refs and actions from useHostFlow().

decisions: Live sub-step state stored in useHostFlow singleton so FlowLayout can optionally show sub-step progress

steps.task: Add FlowWaiting and FlowStreaming routes in router.ts. Add child routes: { path: 'waiting', component: FlowWaiting } and { path: 'streaming', component: FlowStreaming } under the /stream parent.

Update FlowLayout.vue progress bar to be dynamic based on uploadMode. Upload branch: Info→Mode→Upload→Confirm→Waiting→Live. Live branch: Info→Mode→Setup→Waiting→Live. Show progress bar for 'waiting' and 'streaming' steps.

decisions: Progress bar computed dynamically per branch rather than static 4-step display

steps.task: Update FlowSelectMode.vue: change disabled Live <div> to a <button> with @click handler calling flow.selectMode('live') + router.push('/stream/live'). Remove 'Coming Soon' badge. Keep same card styling.

Rewrite FlowLive.vue as multi-sub-step wizard for B.1–B.3 only (OS selection, tutorial, test stream). Internal liveStep ref: 'os-select'|'tutorial'|'test'. Back navigation available from B.1–B.2, locked during active test.

B.1 — OS Selection sub-step: Three clickable cards (Windows/macOS/Linux with icons). selectedOs ref. 'Next →' proceeds to tutorial after selection. '← Back' returns to mode selection via router.push('/stream/mode').

B.2 — Streaming Tutorial sub-step: Content varies by selectedOs. macOS: BlackHole install guide + external audio section (reuse text from StreamPage.vue L251-258). Windows: screen share audio via getDisplayMedia. Linux: PulseAudio/PipeWire monitor source. Audio device dropdown using useAudioCapture.refreshDevices()+devices. 'Select & Continue →' once device captured. '← Back' to OS selection.

B.3 — Test Stream sub-step: Uses useStreamTest composable. 'Start Test' button → 10s capture+send → 'Listening...' → playback. Audio level meter via useAudioMeter during capture. 'Test passed ✓'/'Try Again' result buttons. On pass: flow.setLiveTestPassed(), 'Continue →' navigates to router.push('/stream/waiting'). '← Back' to tutorial (only before/after test).

decisions: Single-page wizard over child routes: FlowLive manages liveStep internally, avoids cluttering the router

steps.task: Update FlowConfirm.vue: replace pre-listen placeholder with functional AudioPlayer.vue (WaveSurfer.js waveform player) fed by flow.prerecordedUrl. After confirming, show 'Continue to Waiting Room →' button navigating to /stream/waiting instead of static 'You're all set' message.

Create FlowWaiting.vue — shared waiting room page for both upload and live branches. Countdown to show.start_time + show.date (Europe/Berlin). Alert states at 1min (yellow pulse) and 10sec (red pulse + audible beep). 'Go Live'/'Start Show' button enabled at countdown=0. No back button.

sub_plan.description: Shared waiting room with countdown and mode-specific behavior

steps.task: Create FlowWaiting.vue skeleton: show info card (title, date, time, artists), countdown display (HH:MM:SS). Compute target datetime from show.start_time + show.date in Europe/Berlin timezone. Update every second via setInterval, clean up on unmount.
Add alert states: normal display, 1-minute warning (yellow pulse CSS animation), 10-second warning (red pulse + audible beep via AudioContext oscillator). Beep plays once per second in final 10s.

Add mode-specific sections. Live mode: audio device status indicator (green=capturing, red=lost) — useAudioCapture keeps running from test step. Upload mode: passive 'Your set is ready' message. 'Go Live'/'Start Show' button enabled when countdown ≤ 0.

On 'Go Live' button press for live mode: connect useStreamSocket, wire useAudioCapture.onData → streamSocket.send(), transition to /stream/streaming. For upload mode: just navigate to /stream/streaming (backend/admin handles playback).

decisions: Countdown based on show.start_time + show.date — no admin-triggered signal needed
No back button from waiting room — artist is committed at this point
Audible beep in final 10 seconds via Web Audio API oscillator

steps.task: Create FlowStreaming.vue — shared streaming room placeholder for both branches. Adapts UI based on flow.uploadMode. Common: status dot, elapsed timer, show info, placeholder panels for future features. Live: level meter, volume slider, stop button. Upload: passive monitoring.

sub_plan.description: Shared streaming room with mode-adaptive UI

steps.task: Create FlowStreaming.vue skeleton: stream status indicator (colored dot with pulse, reuse pattern from StreamPage.vue L143-149), elapsed time counter (Date.now() delta, updated every second), show info card.

Live mode additions: audio level meter (useAudioMeter), volume slider (useAudioCapture.setInputVolume()), 'Stop Streaming' button → streamSocket.disconnect() + audioCapture.stopCapture(). Show stream ended confirmation on disconnect.
Upload (pre-recorded) mode: 'Your set is playing' status message, stream monitoring via streamApi.status() polling (5s interval), no active controls. Show info about current playback state.

Add greyed-out placeholder panels for future features: listener count, audio quality dashboard, live chat. Each shows 'Coming soon' label. On stream end: 'Stream ended' confirmation with option to return to show info.

decisions: B.5 is a functional placeholder — basic controls only; dashboard, listeners, chat deferred to future plan
UI adapts to mode: live gets active controls, pre-recorded gets passive monitoring

steps.task: Frontend build verification: npm run build + npm run test. Fix any TypeScript errors, import issues, or test failures introduced by the new/updated files.

End-to-end manual verification. Test both branches: (A) Upload: Info→Mode→Upload→Confirm (pre-listen audio)→Confirm→Waiting→Streaming (passive). (B) Live: Info→Mode→Live→OS Select→Tutorial→device select→Test Stream (verify loopback audio)→Waiting→Go Live→Streaming (active). Verify back nav works from B.1/B.2 but not waiting room. Verify progress bar updates per branch.
